prompt: The handset's replacement was authorized, but Friday's courier collects only equipment assigned to the repair shop. The handset must stay at the desk until the replacement arrives, because its inventory tag has to be transferred to the new unit in person. Although the paperwork is complete, the desk must _____ on Friday.
promptZh: 這支話機已核准換新，但星期五的快遞只收要送往維修店的設備。舊話機必須留在櫃檯等新機送達，因為要當場把財產標籤移貼到新機上。雖然手續已辦完，櫃檯人員星期五仍須_____。

options.text: send the handset with the repair shipment
options.zh: 把話機併入維修件寄出
options.whyZh: 已核准的是換新，不是送修，快遞星期五不收這類設備。

options.text: remove the inventory tag and release the handset
options.zh: 拆下財產標籤後交出話機
options.whyZh: 標籤要等新機到了再當場移貼，不能先交出舊機。

options.text: keep the handset out of the courier pickup
options.zh: 把話機留在快遞收件範圍之外
options.whyZh: 星期五的快遞只收送修品，且舊話機仍要留櫃檯等新機，以便當場移貼標籤。

options.text: have the courier carry the handset once the tag has been recorded
options.zh: 記下標籤後就讓快遞帶走話機
options.whyZh: 沒說記下標籤可以代替當場移貼，且這不是送修件。

explanationZh: 星期五的快遞只收送修品，且舊話機仍要留櫃檯等新機，以便當場移貼標籤。
evidence: Friday's courier collects only equipment assigned to the repair shop / its inventory tag has to be transferred to the new unit in person

vocabulary.note: 用於辨識、追蹤機構持有的設備，通常印有編號。
